A340E (2JZ—GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION – TROUBLESHOOTING

DTC 89 TRAC ECU Circuit

— CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION —

When the transmission is in the shift up or stall condition, the TRAC ECU sends a sub–throttle valve close signal to the sub–throttle actuator.

DTC No. | Diagnostic Code Detection Condition | Trouble Area

89 | All conditions below are detected 5 secs. or more.
(a) No.1 vehicle speed sensor: 9 km/h (5.6 mph) or more
(b) Mirror check of TRAC ECU input signal is abnormal.
(c) TRAC ECU input signal does not inform to ECM.
(d) TRAC ECU input signal order is abnormal. | Harness or connector between TRAC ECU and ECM
